MEETING REPORT

Meeting report

The 10th ASVB meeting took place in Shenzhen alongside the 2nd Conference on Vascular Homeostasis and Diseases. The joint programme examined how vessels maintain homeostasis and what happens when that balance is disturbed.

ASVB, the School of Medicine and the Homeostatic Medicine Institute at Southern University of Science and Technology jointly convened the event, with support from the Guangdong Pharmacological Society and local organizers in Shenzhen.

The joint forum announced its own theme, “探讨疾病机制，护佑血管健康” (exploring disease mechanisms and protecting vascular health). Joint meeting announcement

Vascular homeostasis and remodelling

Researchers discussed vascular remodelling and disease mechanisms, including how discoveries from the laboratory could inform prevention, diagnosis and treatment.

Tony J. F. Lee Memorial Lecture

Maik Gollasch discussed perivascular adipose tissue and its role in hypertension.

Early-career presentations

The joint programme included a dedicated early-career track with thematic and oral presentations, alongside the plenary and ASVB sessions.
